title: Prediction of regional lymph node metastasis from the clinicopathological features of breast carcinoma: application of deep learning
core_idea: Develop and evaluate a deep learning model that uses routinely available clinicopathological features (age, tumor size, grade, ER/PR/HER2, Ki-67, microvessel density) to predict regional lymph node metastasis in invasive ductal carcinoma patients, aiming to improve diagnostic accuracy and reduce reliance on invasive procedures.
tldr: A neural network was designed to predict regional lymph node metastasis in invasive ductal carcinoma using eight clinicopathological inputs from clinical cases, with the goal of enhancing staging and minimizing invasive assessment.
